tag1.description: The word or phrase that tells who or what the sentence is about
tag1.name: Subject

tag10.description: The base form of a verb preceded by “to”
tag10.name: To-infinitive

tag11.description: An -ing form of a verb used as a noun
tag11.name: Gerund

tag12.description: A present or past participle form of a verb
tag12.name: Participle

tag13.description: A word that connects words, phrases, or clauses
tag13.name: Conjunction

tag14.description: A phrase headed by a participle
tag14.name: Participle phrase

tag15.description: A phrase consisting of a preposition and its object
tag15.name: Prepositional phrase

tag16.description: A phrase headed by a noun, along with any modifiers
tag16.name: Noun phrase

tag17.description: A phrase that functions as an adverb
tag17.name: Adverbial phrase

tag18.description: A phrase headed by a verb
tag18.name: Verb phrase

tag19.description: A phrase that functions as an adjective
tag19.name: Adjectival phrase

tag2.description: A word that expresses an action or a state
tag2.name: Verb

tag20.description: A phrase headed by a gerund
tag20.name: Gerund phrase

tag21.description: A phrase consisting of an infinitive and related words
tag21.name: Infinitive phrase

tag22.description: A clause joined to another clause of equal grammatical status
tag22.name: Coordinating clause

tag23.description: A clause that follows the same grammatical pattern as another clause
tag23.name: Parallel clause

tag24.description: A clause that functions as a noun
tag24.name: Noun clause

tag25.description: A clause that functions as an adjective
tag25.name: Adjectival clause

tag26.description: A clause that functions as an adverb
tag26.name: Adverbial clause

tag27.description: A clause inserted into another clause
tag27.name: Inserted clause

tag28.description: A clause that supplies information about a related noun or expression
tag28.name: Relative clause

tag29.description: A clause that depends on another clause to form a complete sentence
tag29.name: Dependent clause

tag3.description: A verb used with another verb to express ideas such as ability, possibility, or obligation
tag3.name: Modal verb

tag30.description: A clause that can stand on its own as a complete sentence
tag30.name: Independent clause

tag31.description: A word that modifies a verb, an adjective, or another adverb
tag31.name: Adverb

tag32.description: A constituent that identifies or describes the subject
tag32.name: subject complement

tag33.description: A constituent that adds information such as time, place, manner, or reason to a clause
tag33.name: adverbial

tag34.description: A constituent that supplies a place or direction required by the verb
tag34.name: locative complement

tag35.description: Have used with a past participle to form the perfect
tag35.name: perfect auxiliary

tag36.description: Be used with a present participle to form the progressive
tag36.name: progressive auxiliary

tag37.description: Be used with a past participle to form the passive
tag37.name: passive auxiliary

tag38.description: Do used to form questions, negation, or emphasis
tag38.name: do-support auxiliary

tag4.description: A word or phrase affected by the action of a verb
tag4.name: Object

tag5.description: A word or phrase that identifies the recipient or beneficiary of an action
tag5.name: Indirect object

tag6.description: A word or phrase directly affected by the action of a verb
tag6.name: Direct object

tag7.description: A word or phrase governed by a preposition
tag7.name: Prepositional object

tag8.description: A word or phrase that describes or completes a subject or object
tag8.name: Complement

tag9.description: A word or phrase that describes or completes an object
tag9.name: Object complement
